neighbours.label: a verb presenting how something proves to be: appears, turned out, was found (before a description of a property)
fire: Under a lens the crystal appears blue and slightly cloudy.
From below, the tail feathers appear to be pale grey.
The simple fix turned out to be much harder than planned.
Such doses may be found unsafe in younger patients.
The enzyme appeared to be stable at room temperature.
In time the plan turned out to be quite costly.
The ancient wall appears to be almost untouched by weather.
Rates that work in one region may be found too low in another.
quiet: Under a lens the crystal was split with a small blade.
From below, the tail feathers are hidden by the wings.
The simple fix was carried out by a plumber from town.
Such doses are stored in a locked cabinet by the nurses.
The enzyme was added to the flask at room temperature.
In time the plan was sent to the board for a vote.
The ancient wall runs along the northern edge of the town.
Rates that work in one region are printed in the booklet.

notes: 'seems to be' and 'looks' scored only 0.06 in one probe, so this is narrower than all seem-verbs.
